steps: Step 1: A ray of light travels towards the mirror.
Step 2: Draw the normal at right angles to the mirror where the ray meets it.
Step 3: The angle of incidence is measured from the normal, not from the mirror.
Step 4: The ray leaves with the angle of reflection equal to the angle of incidence.
alt.summary: A ray of light meets a flat mirror and reflects; a dashed normal stands at right angles to the mirror, and the angle of incidence i on one side of it matches the angle of reflection r on the other.

entry.alt_text: A ray of light meets a flat mirror and reflects; a dashed normal stands at right angles to the mirror, and the angle of incidence i on one side of it matches the angle of reflection r on the other.
entry.attribution: Our own drawing, made for Jana with AI assistance.

parts.function: The ray of light travelling towards the mirror.
parts.name: Incident ray

parts.function: A line at right angles to the mirror where the ray meets it; both angles are measured from it.
parts.name: Normal

parts.function: The angle between the incident ray and the normal.
parts.name: Angle of incidence

parts.function: The ray of light leaving the mirror after reflection.
parts.name: Reflected ray

parts.function: The angle between the reflected ray and the normal; it equals the angle of incidence.
parts.name: Angle of reflection

parts.function: A flat reflecting surface; the hatching marks its back.
parts.name: Plane mirror

steps.caption: A ray of light travels towards the mirror.
Draw the normal at right angles to the mirror where the ray meets it.
The angle of incidence is measured from the normal, not from the mirror.
The ray leaves with the angle of reflection equal to the angle of incidence.
